[id 30] Let the common ratio factor be \(x\). Then \(7x + 11x = 162\), so \(18x = 162\) and \(x = 9\). Allen is \(11 \times 9 = 99\) now, so in 10 years he will be \(99 + 10 = 109\).

[id 31] The guesses are 80, \(80/2 + 20 = 60\), and \(1.25 \times 80 = 100\). Their average is \((80 + 60 + 100) / 3 = 240 / 3 = 80\).

[id 32] Daily time is \(10 \times 0.5 = 5\) hours. Over 7 days that is \(5 \times 7 = 35\) hours.

[id 33] Let silver coins be \(s\). Then gold is \(s + 30\). So \(s + (s + 30) = 110\), giving \(2s = 80\) and \(s = 40\). Gold coins: \(40 + 30 = 70\).

[id 34] Aaron has \(40/2 + 5 = 25\) jewels. Siobhan has \(25 - 2 = 23\) jewels.

[id 35] First 20 minutes: 4 points. Second 20 minutes: \(4 + 0.25 \times 4 = 5\) points. Total: \(4 + 5 = 9\) points.

[id 36] In 30 days Terry eats \(2 \times 30 = 60\) yogurts. At 4 for $5, he needs \(60/4 = 15\) packs. Cost: \(15 \times 5 = 75\) dollars.

[id 37] Money used for games plus remaining is \(8 \times 20 + 5 = 165\) dollars. At $15 per set, he sold \(165 / 15 = 11\) sets. He still has \(13 - 11 = 2\) sets.

[id 38] He runs \(3 + 1.5 + 1.5 = 6\) hours per week. Speed is \(60 / 6 = 10\) miles per hour.

[id 39] Running speed is \(2 \times 3 = 6\) mph. Walking speed is \(6 / 4 = 1.5\) mph. She runs for 2 hours (\(6 \times 2 = 12\) miles) and walks for 4 hours (\(1.5 \times 4 = 6\) miles). Total distance: \(12 + 6 = 18\) miles.
